subject: Post-call recap: Exec summary & next steps (Pioneer Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Exec summary & next steps (Pioneer Health)

Sarah —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick executive recap and proposed next steps (pulled from our conversation):

Top pain points we heard
- Inconsistent latency and high cost on current LLM endpoints during peak hours (affects clinician-facing features)
- Data residency and auditability requirements for PHI-adjacent telemetry
- Lack of predictable SLA / escalation path for production incidents

Goals & success metrics
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~40% at 95th-percentile traffic
- Sub-200ms median latency for short-form clinical prompts (<=256 tokens)
- SOC2 evidence + audit log retention to satisfy procurement by Dec 2026

Procurement path & timeline you outlined
- Internal approval (exec sponsor: Sarah Jensen) — target: late Oct
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 review — procurement will run Nov
- Contract and pricing review with procurement — target: mid-Nov
- Go/no-go decision — target: Dec 10, 2026

Key risks / escalation items
- Data residency: Pioneer requires EU/US region isolation for certain data flows — confirming scope of telemetry that needs residency guarantees
- SLA exception for initial pilot—I signalled potential need for a written escalation SLA for the pilot window

Proposed next steps (owners & timing)
1) Executive briefing (30 min) to your leadership + procurement — target week of Oct 18 — owner: Marissa (I'll send calendar options)
2) Share SOC2 summary & architecture notes (we'll include data residency controls) — owner: Aditya — by Oct 15
3) Draft mutual action plan (MAP) and rough pricing for pilot (3 months) — owner: Marissa — by Oct 14 (attached: Pioneer-MVP-pricing.xlsx, Draft-MAP.docx)
4) Procurement questionnaire kickoff — Pioneer to share questionnaire; Redwood will assign security lead — timing: as soon as you send the RFP/Q

If this matches your view, can you confirm the procurement timeline and who we should loop in from your side (procurement contact + legal)?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar options for the exec briefing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Pioneer-MVP-pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet), Draft-MAP.docx (proposal)

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@pioneerhealth.com>, procurement@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Exec summary & next steps (Pioneer Health)

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap; this looks right. A few clarifications from my side:

- Timeline: internal exec approval should be complete by Oct 25 (we have a leadership sync then). Procurement lead (Tom Alvarez) will run the security review in November — target completion Nov 30.
- Data residency: we need a clear statement of what telemetry Redwood collects and whether it can be configured to stay in our US region. For PHI-related fields we will require signed controls.
- Pilot: Procurement will want a short pilot agreement (30–90 days) with defined SLOs and an escalation path.

I've looped in Tom (procurement) — Tom, can you confirm who from legal/procurement should be included in the MAP review and whether Pioneer will use a redlined PO or an MSAs + SOW approach?

Also — please add any SOC2 evidence and a short architecture doc to help speed the review.

Best,
Sarah Jensen
VP, Digital Products | Pioneer Health
sarah.jensen@pioneerhealth.com | (617) 555-2210

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — I'll own the SOC2 artifacts and the technical write-up on data residency. Quick notes:

- SOC2: I will attach the SOC2 summary (controls mapping) and a short extract of our audit log retention policy. If Pioneer wants the full report we'll coordinate an NDA + report delivery.
- Data residency: Redwood supports regional tenancy for inference and telemetry; we'll confirm which telemetry fields (usage/event-level vs prompt content) can be disabled or routed to customer-managed storage.
- Pilot SLOs: recommend we propose latency P95 and availability SLOs with a short-term exception window and a defined escalation contact (we should propose a named on-call).

I'll draft the tech appendix and drop the SOC2-summary link here by EOD Oct 15.

Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
